title: Fourier estimator with confidence parameters
statement: Let $\mathcal{F}$ be a nonempty finite family of subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and let $\varepsilon,\delta\in\mathbb{Q}$ satisfy $0<\varepsilon\leq\tfrac12$ and $0<\delta\leq\tfrac12$. The program draws the number of independent uniform sign-cube inputs prescribed per coefficient by the family’s accuracy and confidence parameters, then runs the queried finite-family Fourier estimator on them and returns a sparse Fourier hypothesis with rational coefficients.
caveat: The accuracy, confidence-allocation, and sample-count functions are not defined in the supplied definitions, so the sample size cannot be made more explicit.
